text:
Priya: Quick thread to finalize run-of-show and contingency wording for tomorrow's webinar. Need short handoff scripts and who posts the follow-up asset links.
Marta: Draft run: 0:00 host intro (Priya) 4m, 4:00 why cost+latency matter (Sam) 8m, 12:00 benchmark narrative + charts (Ethan) 10m, 22:00 live demo (Marta+Ethan) 14m, 36:00 customer vignette + Q&A 24m. Keep 3m buffer at the end.
Ethan: I'll shorten the benchmark slides to 6 charts. Also prepping two narrative hooks: "latency as UX" and "cost per 1k tokens". Which do we lead with?
Sam: Lead with latency-as-UX for the first 5 minutes, then pivot to cost metrics tied to batching/quantization. Will include one slide showing tradeoffs.
Jia: Infra: demo endpoint warmed on us-west-2. I created a low-latency alias demo-fast and a cost-saver demo-quant. Ready to flip if needed; added a dashboard alert to #stage-ops when p95 > 900ms for 2 minutes.
Marta: Who posts follow-up assets in chat (deck, transcript, demo video)? We need ASAP after recording finishes.
Priya: I'll post the deck and transcript. Can someone stage the YouTube upload and timestamped clip?
Ethan: I'll handle recording upload and create a short 90s clip for social.
Sam: For live fallback script, use this short paste: "We're switching to a recorded demo to keep things smooth. The recording and transcript will be posted in chat. Keep your questions coming!" Copyable.
ops-bot: Reminder: Rehearsal in 30m.
Marta: Small ops notes: 1) spotlight demo speakers, 2) mute attendees on join, 3) enable Q&A panel for questions, 4) stage ops posts fallback link if demo flips.
Jia: One more: record a 3-min cold-start clip that can be played if endpoint spin-up lags. It's already in /webinars/assets/fallback_clips/short_demo.mp4.
Priya: Timing cues: I will ping at 30s left for each segment and call for transition. Please keep answers crisp during Q&A.
Sam: Confirming console monitoring duty for me, Marta you handle chat moderation, Jia on infra. Ethan will take the post-upload.
Marta: All set. Last call: anyone need an extra practice pass? We can do a quick 20-min run 45m before live.
Ethan: I can join.
Priya: I'll be there.
Jia: Confirmed.
Sam: Confirmed.
Marta: Great. Posting final lobby note and handoff checklist to the drive now. Close thread unless something urgent.
